meta.title: Tracecart — Find it. Get it there.
meta.description: Tell us the tool or equipment you need, even if you don't know its name: we find it, buy it and deliver it. Already have the goods? We move them. One delivered price.

hero.eyebrow: Find the tools you need. Get them delivered.
hero.titleBefore: What if the tool you need
hero.subtitleRest: the tools, equipment and parts you're looking for, or move the goods you already have.
hero.imageAlt: A woman in safety glasses drilling into a wall

tool.title: A new tool
tool.body: A drill, a saw, a measuring device: describe it or show it, and we find where to buy it and deliver it.

equipment.title: Servers for your company
equipment.body: Servers, computers, network gear: we find the models you need and send you one delivered price.

part.title: The part with no name
part.body: A worn part from a pump or a generator: a photo is enough to start the search.

move.title: Goods to move
move.body: Already have them? We pick them up and deliver them, and you follow each step to the door.

pov.before: Most suppliers sell what they have in stock. Most forwarders sell a truck.
pov.accent: We start from what you need,
pov.after: find the right tool, and bring it to your door for one price.

services.eyebrow: From the first search to your door
services.title: What are you looking for today?

sourcing.title: Find the right tool
sourcing.body: A photo, a part number or a few words is enough. We identify the product, compare suppliers and check it's the right one before you pay.
sourcing.imageAlt: A coordinator reviewing a request at her desk

freight.title: Transport
freight.body: Already have the goods? We pick them up and move them with the carrier that fits the load and the date.
freight.imageAlt: A container ship loaded at a port

customs.title: Customs and paperwork
customs.body: Duties estimated up front, documents ready before the border, broker fees shown apart. If you clear customs yourself, you don't pay us for it.
customs.imageAlt: A stack of clipped shipping documents

tracking.title: Delivery you can follow
tracking.body: Each step as it happens, an honest arrival date, and photographed proof at the door.
tracking.imageAlt: Two customers following their delivery on a phone

process.title: How it works.
process.subtitle: One delivered price, from your first message to your door.

tell.title: Tell us what you need
tell.body: Describe the tool or send a photo, even without its name. Or give us the pickup address of goods you already have.

price.title: Get one delivered price
price.body: We find the right product and the route. One price, delivery included, valid for a week.

follow.title: Follow it to your door
follow.body: Each step as it happens, delays with a reason, and proof at the door.

price.them: Hunting across shops, never sure it's the right part
price.us: Describe it once: we find the right product and check it

tracking.them: Buy from one, ship with another, pay customs on arrival
tracking.us: One delivered price before you commit, customs shown apart

space.them: A tracking number that stops at the port
space.us: Every step to your door, every delay with a reason

footer.disclaimer: The price at checkout covers the item, delivery, customs duties and taxes. It is fixed when you order, and nothing is added at delivery. Delivery dates are estimates. A freight estimate is indicative, and a quote holds until the date shown on it. Trademarks belong to their owners.
